welcome:
Hello!
I'm the official 🤵🏻 Mafia game bot.
private_only_commands: This command only works in private chat.
group_only_settings: Only the group owner can use this command.
admin_bonus_granted:
✅ Admin rights received!
Type /game to start registration.
reg_started:
📋 Registration is open
Joined players:

{players}

Total: {count} people.

reg_already_active: ⚠️ There is already an active registration or game in this group.
night_intro:
🌚 🌃 Night
Only the brave and fearless went out into the streets. In the morning we'll count who survived...
no_one_died: Hard to believe, but no one died tonight...
someone_died:
You were mercilessly hanged :(
You may say your last words:
died_announce: {name} was brutally killed during the night. Rumor has it {killer_role} paid a visit.
vote_start: ⚖️ Time to find the guilty and punish them.
vote_choose: Who do you want to vote for?
vote_tie:
Voting finished:
The city couldn't agree... No one was hanged.
vote_hanged:
{name} was hanged at the town meeting!
They were {role}.
desc_don: Your task is to decide who to eliminate each night.
desc_mafia: Your task is to vote with the Don on who to eliminate at night.
desc_civilian: Your task is to find the mafia and vote to hang them.
desc_commissioner: Your task is to find the mafia. You check one player each night.
desc_doctor: Your task is to save someone's life at night.
night_don_choose: You are the Don. Who do you eliminate?
night_doctor_choose: You are the Doctor. Who do you heal?
night_commissioner_choose: You are the Commissioner. Who do you check?

stop_no_active: There is no active game in this group.

vaqt_no_active: Registration is not active right now.

qoida_default: 📜 Rules have not been set by the admin yet.

Please transfer {amount} UZS to the card below:

💳 8600 1234 5678 9012
